about.title: Torrance Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Five people died on Torrance streets in 2025, the city's most recent final collision count. Behind each number was a parent, a partner, a son or daughter, someone expected home who didn't arrive. What your family may need now is not pressure but a clear explanation of what California allows you to do next. A wrongful death claim is a civil action. It runs separately from any criminal case, whether the loss happened on Hawthorne Boulevard, along Pacific Coast Highway, on the I-405, at a workplace, or in a hospital. The law gives certain family members, a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then specific dependents and heirs, the right to seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and compensation for lost love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Torrance families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. Reach out when you are ready.

whyChoose.title: What a Torrance Family Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Only certain relatives can file
items.desc: California puts a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first in line, followed by specific dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family has standing before anything is filed.

items.title: The clock is real, and sometimes shorter
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be brought within two years of the date of death. If a public agency such as the city, county, or state was involved, the window to give notice is considerably shorter.

items.title: The losses the law recognizes
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial expenses, the income and support the person would have contributed, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. None of it brings them back, but the law does not pretend those losses are zero.

items.question: My relative was killed on the I-405 near Torrance. Does that change who I file against?
items.answer: It can. The San Diego Freeway is a state route, so if a road condition or a Caltrans or other government vehicle played any role, your claim may involve a public entity with a much shorter notice deadline than the standard two years. An attorney can determine quickly whether that applies to your situation, which is one reason not to wait.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action and does not depend on a conviction or even on charges being filed. The two proceedings run on different tracks, and the civil case uses a different standard of proof. Your attorney can coordinate around the criminal case without letting your own deadline slip.

items.question: We were not married, but we lived together for years. Can I bring a claim?
items.answer: A registered domestic partner has the same standing as a spouse under California law. If the partnership was not registered, standing becomes more complicated and may depend on whether you were financially dependent on the person who died. This is exactly the kind of question an independent attorney should review with you early, and LawProactive can connect you with one for free.
